Subject: Cloud store eligibility & support runbook - AWS/GCP listing questions

Hi Sonia,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're getting ACME Analytics queued for an initial listing across AWS and GCP, and I want to make sure we gather everything your listing and co-sell teams will need up front so we don't get stuck in legal or sourcing back-and-forth. Two requests from our side: a) a short eligibility template we can fill with technical/commercial evidence, and b) a mapping for our support claims (e.g., "24x7 support", "business hours + on-call") to the marketplace support SLOs and what evidence is acceptable.

High-level questions we want to resolve before we publish:
- Is a single eligibility packet sufficient for cross-cloud listing, or do AWS/GCP require separate evidence?
- Are there any required statements about key management (KMS/HSM) or data residency we should include in the eligibility doc?
- For "24x7 support" claims, what operational evidence is required (ticketing SLA, escalation contacts, on-call policy, runbooks)?
- Any special branding/trademark checks for marketing copy or logos in the listing?

If you already have a short template or a vendor-friendly checklist we can fill, please send it over and we'll populate today. We're aiming to have a complete packet to you by EOD Friday (2028-07-21).

Thanks — appreciate it.

Naomi Feldman
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Hi Naomi,

Great to hear — thanks for the clear list. Attaching two templates we use that should cover both AWS and GCP intake: a short Eligibility_Template.xlsx (required fields we validate) and an SLA_Mapping_Template.csv (how marketplace support levels map to public claims). For branding, see the quick notes below.

Quick answers:
- One filled eligibility packet is usually fine for initial submission; we may ask for cloud-specific artifacts (e.g., region-specific privacy docs) during review.
- KMS: a short statement of whether you manage keys or the cloud provider does is required (include KMS region and any HSM usage).
- 24x7 claim: we need a published on-call rota or ticketing snippet showing 24/7 coverage + an escalation matrix that includes a named contact and a measurable target (e.g., P1 ack within 1 hour).
- Branding: you must provide vector logo files and any trademark ownership statements; marketing copy that implies SLA guarantees ("always available") needs to be toned down to measurable commitments.

Attaching:
- Eligibility_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- SLA_Mapping_Template.csv (text/csv)

Next steps: fill the templates and return to MarketplaceOps. If you'd like co-sell engagement we can kick the co-sell MOU once the eligibility packet is accepted. I copied ops to track intake.

Cheers,
Sonia Patel
Partner Programs, AWS Marketplace
sonia.patel@aws-partner.com
[attachment: Eligibility_Template.xlsx, SLA_Mapping_Template.csv]

Thanks Naomi — taking this on. Quick notes from a 1st pass against our ops: 

- SLA mapping: I matched our current support plan to the SLA_Mapping_Template.csv and attached a filled version (support_sla_mapping_filled.csv).
- Evidence: attached a redacted ticketing export (sample_tickets_redacted.txt) and an on-call rota PDF snippet. The P1 ack time currently targets 45 minutes (we'll need to decide whether to claim 1h for marketplace consistency).
- KMS: we need a short statement from Infrastructure about customer-managed keys vs. provider-managed keys. I've flagged this to infra but including placeholder text in the eligibility sheet.
- Risk: both AWS and GCP will push back on "24x7 premium support" wording without a formal escalation SLA. If we want the tighter claim, Legal will need to sign off on an escalation SLA and we need an explicit runbook.

Attachments I've prepared for the packet:
- support_sla_mapping_filled.csv
- sample_tickets_redacted.txt
- oncall_rota_snippet.pdf
- brand_assets_v1.zip (see Vanessa for final assets)

I recommend we claim "24x7 monitored support with P1 escalation target: 1 hour" in copy to be conservative.
